notes.title: Release Date, 100 Items, Synergy, Rebalancing, Consumable Slot, And Much More!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36651033/90c26db36e16fe2cecf2b74d98552c2ba60c01c3.png[/img]
First of all, we have a big news! We finally have official release date for [u][b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1043260/Gladiator_Guild_Manager/]Early Access: October 14th![/url][/b][/u] 

There is so much work to be done till then, but we’re giving it all we have. It’s been almost 1 year since the release of [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1332470/Gladiator_Guild_Manager_Prologue/]Demo-Prologue[/url] and game has grown a lot. Especially because of your suggestions and valuable feedback that made the game so much better!





We are planing to keep working full time on the game during Early Access and add all new features we want and lots of new content. But don’t worry, Early Access will already be fully playable and fun experience that will just keep growing ːsteamhappyː

Join our [url=https://discord.gg/J7Ja2cK][b]Discord Community[/b][/url], follow up progress closely and chat with us to help us make the game into something all of us will enjoy!


[h1]What is new in version 0.649?[/h1]
If you prefer video version of the update we have it on youtube, together with some in gameplay examples:
[previewyoutube=__KvgGhU_vg;full][/previewyoutube]


[h2]Items[/h2]

[h3]Around 100 new items[/h3]
There are now about 100 items in the game. You’ll start with raggy and cheap items and as you grow you’ll be able to afford more and more powerful items.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36651033/294484719078896153da9b2699e5ad34feafdc7f.gif[/img]

[h3]Universal Items For Synergetic Strategies[/h3]
This is the new type of items called Universal Items. They do not have a level because they are based on percentages and are useful throughout the whole game. 
Here is one example:
[b]Spiked Chestplate[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36651033/7e842cde2fc12480f187a19a5c4cf0ae3f9ec27b.png[/img]
This item returns percentage of damage dealt to gladiator. [i](We had something similar but we moved it to Universal item type now)[/i]

Most of currently implemented Universal Items are focused on Synergy. Like:
[b]Arrowhead of Frost[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36651033/d87c6d6c52017970aec603403654db759c45999d.png[/img]
Item that make gladiator's projectiles deals 30% higher damage to frozen enemies. So you can combine this with Cryomancers freeze ability for maximum efficiency. 

Each Universal item has Basic, Rare and Epic version. Each less frequent in shop, more expensive but stronger. 
Eventually we plan to make a crafting system where you can combine 3 lower tier Universal items to craft one higher tier item.

[h3]Consumable Item Slots[/h3]
Finally we have a solution for consumable items that will make them useful. Now gladiators have one slot for consumable item so you can still have powerfully equipped gladiator and make them even stronger with consumable.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36651033/f259b40a97cb0adf1bde071a9afe8ad022863957.jpg[/img]
They are also now a bit cheaper and a bit stronger than before.



[h3]Item Shop[/h3]
In item shop you can find Regular, Consumable and Universal items. Till now shop used to provide tier of items that are the same as last championship arena you defeated. Now from time to time, there is a chance to get an more advanced item from tier above. As well as Universal items that also appear less frequently. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36651033/6803802884ec651bc8d26eec372a70ea8d821b70.jpg[/img]

[h3]Item Panel[/h3]
Now with left click you can open Item Panel containing all information about item as well as buy/sell buttons.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36651033/5ce1d399ea8956ebcdfd5c8880f44180f6da3a1b.jpg[/img]

[h2]Gladiator Total Rebalancing And AI Improvements[/h2]

[h3]Rebalancing[/h3]
First off, we were made aware of a big issue by community that levels are giving gladiators way too much power. So even if you have a gladiator that is being countered by enemy gladiator. If your gladiator is just a few levels higher they will not have issue defeating their counter. For this reason we decreased the amount of points each new level brings. Levels are still very important, but this allows game to be more strategic rather than promoting the brute force gameplay.
To follow up this rebalance, items stats are also reduced. 

[h3]Gladiator Stats[/h3]
Second huge issue we had was that most gladiators had one stat that was most important and choosing to level up that stat would be the only viable option for some of them.
For example Archer would get damage, dodge, and attack speed all from agility. Making most of her other stats pretty superfluous.

So we took a step back and rebalanced the whole game. 
[list]
[*]Now choosing between strength and agility would mean choosing between speed and damage. 
[*]Intelligence is used for damage and other effects for spell-casters, but they still need other stats to decrease their cooldown or execution speed.
[*]Stamina used to be fairly useless for melee fighters as they could still attack without enough stamina but only dealing 20% less damage. Plus many gladiators had terrible stamina balancing. They would use very little and you did not need to put any thought into it. 
Now you’ll sometimes see gladiators just standing and waiting for their stamina to recover before they can swing another attack. In near future we are considering adding “Tired” animation so it’s clearer why they are just waiting. 
But this system is now pushing you to watch battle carefully and notice if some of your gladiators are losing their effectiveness and need more stamina points or items to stay active during battles.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36651033/531561bee10440edfece506512ceeabca4e91312.gif[/img]

[h3]Stamina[/h3]
Gladiators will also stop using defensive abilities if their stamina is lesser than 25%. Otherwise battle takes forever as they waste all their stamina on defending themselves instead of on attacking and finishing up the opponent.
Also gladiators used to use 25% of the stamina of total damage that was prevented. Now they use only 10%. To put it more simply, defensive actions cost less stamina and are more useful.

[h3]Speed of Battle[/h3]
Once gladiator reach certain levels their cooldowns and executions speeds would get extremely fast. Making battle really hard to follow. Now they tend to take longer to attack making it easier to see what is happening. But we always encourage you to slow down the time and take a close look at the battle to understand what is happening and improve your strategy.

[b]Normal Speed:[/b]
[previewyoutube=hVJxcUWO6ZI;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]Slowed Down:[/b]
[previewyoutube=YT3KMp1Fmco;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]Movement speed[/h3]
This stat was pretty much broken. After gladiators would get level 4-5 they would already have maximum movement speed. Now their speed is gradually increasing and if your gladiator needs to move fast across the arena it is worthwhile putting points into it or getting movement speed items.

[h3]More Strategy[/h3]
Overall strategy of choosing points for each gladiators is now very important. You can even build different kinds of gladiators based on it. Do you want super tanky Knight? Give him lots of health and strength. Do you want him to be fast and deal high damage, so he can rush into back line enemies and take them down? Give him agility and movement speed points. 

You’ll find even more interesting variations in different gladiators but we’ll let you explore that. Just be sure to check gladiator ability stats and how they are calculated to understand what each does:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36651033/3715c5a5894567ad6d93ed414e34f49d3735c134.gif[/img]


[h2]Gladiator AI Improvements[/h2]

[h3]Archer (and other ranged gladiators)[/h3]
Her projectile would sometimes go through the targeted enemy if the enemy get very near and enters her minimum range for shooting. Now this is fixed. If she targets the enemy in front of her, her arrow will hit the enemy.

[b]Before fixing this: [/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36651033/9c613152e48e3bc2418817e82a0bbeaee8c94c3c.gif[/img]

[b]After fixing this:[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36651033/86ec7df22fb4c084f46ca1dfccdd19f7736c9649.gif[/img]

Unless the enemy enters her minimum range and she decided to target an enemy that is further away. In that case, arrow would go thought the enemy near her, and will go towards the far away enemy. We need this too, because if she is engaged in melee fight with an enemy, she still needs to be able to shoot far away enemies with arrows as well.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36651033/710d96302432fde303e95b3ced3c27d7ca8b48fc.gif[/img]


[h3]Brigand [/h3]
Brigand used to shoot her spear first and only after that, throw her net that would stop the enemy. This was because at the moment the battle starts she could not tell what the enemy team is about to do. Now this is fixed, and if she is being attacked by melee unit she will make sure to stop the unit with her net first.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36651033/f668fb7ce647993fe6420ad33010d0257461e830.gif[/img]

Despite being a bandit, she can be very generous too. If her ally ranged gladiator is attacked/chased by melee gladiator she will help her out by throwing a net on that enemy to keep her ally safe.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36651033/9dfc34998bac91c4add0286971db639f07a9b931.gif[/img]

[h3]Hunter[/h3]
Our first dwarf in the game got a little smarter as well. He will no longer put traps unless he’s being chased by a melee gladiators. Traps are also bigger so they have higher chance for enemy to fall into them.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36651033/b641971f9f25c52dd21c0fd935d8d8c2599f9f98.gif[/img]
There was a bug where trap would not stop enemy movement. Now it’s fixed.
He can still sometimes stupidly mess up and move in opposite direction of his trap. But we’ll work more on that.

[h2]Synergy Buffs[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36651033/679b89f032b26d4c255ae3f1a4c5970dd74be837.jpg[/img]

[list]
[*]Priestess now has ability to cast Blessed buff. Again visible on gladiator. It increases Primary Stat of friendly gladiator like Invigorator does but less efficient. But it is one of the few synergetic buffs, so in shop you’ll be able to find items that make her heal stronger if she has casted this buff on an ally. 
[*]Cryomancer has Frozen buff (he used to have something similar but now items can recognize this and use it for synergetic effects). 
[*]Pyromancer now has Burning buff instead of knockdown. You can see gladiators burning while the buff is active.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36651033/f15a84d42999961173c99f48c2a29007c581882b.gif[/img]

[h3]Other Buffs[/h3]
[b]Movement Preventing Resistance[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36651033/b29c2a156a68f8e0e02b129a9580fe7e058615d5.png[/img]
“After being stopped from moving 2 times, unit is unable to be stopped from moving during next 12 seconds.”
This is necessary so you can’t perpetually keep somebody in place (especially boss) with Cryomancer and other Movement Preventing gladiators.


[h2]Minor Improvements or Polishes[/h2]

[list]
[*]In Ring of Death - Blind Fight, there were situation where you'd get to put 5 gladiators for fight. And since you just started the game you might only have 3 or 4. Now this is fixed and until you finish first championship you will never get Blind Fight with this many gladiators to place.
[*]Gladiator health bars color are now same as gladiator team color. So ally and enemy gladiators are more easily distinguished during chaotic battles. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36651033/ca31624cd5d20738fc9a9a3c5486c20228642af4.gif[/img]
[*]When you click on bank you can see “Coming Soon” screen for Loan mechanic. It was unclear what that empty space was and why it was called a Bank when you could only trade resources there. 
[*]In Bank when you roll over button to buy/sell resources it’s clear what left and right click do: 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36651033/43b7dacb580a8e2dea3ff32d6f2685f7f789b6ea.jpg[/img]
[*]In Ring of Death - Blind Fight. When you roll over Lock Team button you will see this explanation: 
“After Locking your team, you can still reposition gladiators and give them items from inventory. But you can no longer access other gladiators.”
[*]When you click on Gladiators button “Sell”, now there is pop up screen asking you if you are sure.
[*]Rolling over Ability Stats like Execution Speed or Cooldown show how the stat is calculated (even though the numbers are fairly small).
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36651033/afcb64cbb49fe12a59089b88183144f8cc3e4d33.jpg[/img]
[*]Rolling over wages icon in Timeline will show the total amount of wages that you need to pay this month. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36651033/bd9fc1282892adc615d9dea8c2f0115cf7516f14.jpg[/img]
[*]Various other polishes that will make game feel smoother and more intuitive.
[/list]

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]

[list]
[*]Graveyard Championship bug where epic and rare coupon fights have same difficulty is fixed.
[*]Several Level Editor bugs are fixed.
[*]Gladiators on discount used to show full price when their panel is open. Now it’s fixed.
[*]Gladiator building upgrades were about to increase the XP rate of that gladiator. And this feature was not working at all. Now it’s fixed. It can be even combined with quirk that let’s gladiator gain more XP.
[*]Selling equipped item directly from gladiator then pressing Undo Button would cause bug. 
Also if you sell just an item. And then move it’s position the Undo Sell Button for item would stop working. Now fixed.
[*]And many other various small bug are fixed.
[/list]


[h1]What is Next?[/h1]
Wow! This was the longest update post we ever made ːsteamhappyːːsteamthumbsupː
So I’ll try to wrap this up quickly.
Here is what we are planing to work on next:

[h3]Fatigue/Rest Time[/h3]
We want to implement fatigue feature for gladiators and test out this design that would push you towards making bigger teams and using more strategy, rather than levelling up only a few powerful gladiators and pushing through game with raw force.
We also want to remove cooldown on Ring of Death. But then we'd use gladiator fatigue to limit you from repeatedly playing it and at the same time this would push you towards using different gladiators as well, while your A-Team is resting. 

[h3]Priority Points[/h3]
We want to play around with gladiator priority system. Idea is that we let you tell each gladiator who to focus before the battle starts. Allowing for more strategic gameplay. 
(Game will be playable without this too. But for harder challenges having extra tactics could be what some players are looking for)

[h3]More[/h3]
More content, improved enemy formations, polishing and bug fixing. 

[h2]Thank you![/h2]
As we said. Release Date for [u][b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1043260/Gladiator_Guild_Manager/]Early Access is set to October 14th![/url][/b][/u] Less than 3 months from now!

Join us on our [url=https://discord.gg/J7Ja2cK][b]Discord Community[/b][/url] as we’re doing final changes and adding features before the release. Let’s talk about the game! 

Talking with you guys is what affected more than half of the changes and new contend that you’ll see once Early Access is out!

Cheers! ːsteamhappyː

notes.title: Fixing Final Design - Gladiator Guild Manager Development Plans
notes.content:
We had so much amazing feedback lately as we are getting the game to it's final stage.
There are several very serious issues that can make or break the game. Here are the main ones:
[list]
[*] There is a lot of waiting in the game where you just watch time pass and wait for opportunity to do something.
[*] Optimal way of playing is to just build one small team of gladiators and make them as powerful as possible. We are losing a lot of strategic elements this way. What we intended in first place is that you'd build a larger group of gladiators and use them tactically. Have your top gladiators but also your less effective gladiators that are still useful.
[*] Now that you can assign stat points to gladiators as they level up, the stat balancing issues are more obvious than ever before.
[*] Game could use more depth. We want that "Easy to start, but hard to master" mentality in the game. But our "Hard to master" part of the formula could use some work.
[*] And more smaller things that could make gameplay more engaging.
[/list]

Thanks to all your feedback, as well as ideas from discord, and watching streamers on Twitch like 
[url=https://www.twitch.tv/videos/1058634440]Hillhome[/url] and especially form an amazing analysis video from [url=https://youtu.be/-zHPh0Jue7w]TooTechnical [/url] on youtube we put together a list of things we believe will fix all these issues and make the game at least twice as good.

After putting all these together and thinking it through here is what we are planing to do:
[previewyoutube=Imp-YkW1Uds;full][/previewyoutube]

Video is lengthy. But I go through most important things in first 30 minutes. We'd love to hear your opinion about any part of our plans for the game in order to make the game as good and enjoyable as possible. 

You can join our [url=https://discord.gg/J7Ja2cK]Discord Community[/url] and chat with us about those or any other ideas. Or to follow up development closer and chat with other players.

Thank you all!

notes.title: Update v0.627! Unit Priority Points, Special Units Shop, Random Buildings, More!
notes.content:
Here is another bigger update for Gladiator Guild Manager. 
Join us on [url=https://discord.gg/J7Ja2cK]Discord[/url] and tell us what you think.

[h2]Ring of Death Progress[/h2]
Now each ring of death arena has 12 levels of progress. Each battle getting harder than the previous one. Finishing each 3rd battle brings the item reward.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36651033/6998f7bf2cb4d9248ae43610132ed2aaf75fc822.jpg[/img]
Although at this point we are considering is we should keep this feature or go back to the way it was. 
Just now before the update we realized some issues this feature might bring. For example, if you keep losing some arena, and you maxed out all ring of death modes there won't be much to do, but wait for championship. But for this update we’ll keep it to hear what you guys think and we'll consider what to do in next update.

[h2]Better Gladiator AI and Priority Points Panel[/h2]
Each gladiator now has their own priority setting. 
Before we had some custom settings on some gladiators. Like Worg targeting back-line enemies. But it was limited and flawed. Now with each gladiator having their own setting they should behave a little bit smarter. 
For example, all gladiators highly prioritize enemies that they can attack immediately. Making Worg stop to fight any enemy he comes across. But now this setting is turned off for him, so you can be sure that he’ll run past the front-line fighters and rush towards the back-line ranged and support enemies.

[h2]Priority Points Panel[/h2]
You can turn on Priority Points toggle during battle. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36651033/3eece60bdbf47b2ceff44db3925935175ceeb8c0.jpg[/img]
While it’s turned on, when you click on your gladiator, instead of Unit Info Panel, you will see the units priority points and be able to adjust them.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36651033/aab1a25ce6388721c12121932c161e75c3566ae0.jpg[/img]
They all already have default setting that work the best in most scenarios as they are. But you can tweak them to make them behave differently in some situations. 
Again with Worg example. If you don’t want him to rush towards back line, turn on the “Enemies In Reach” toggle and he’ll behave like he did before. Or even lower his priority of ranged and support enemies and he’ll behave like a Berserker and just fight whoever is nearest. 

Rolling over each of those stats will give you some description of what they do.

These setting are saved. So in order to keep track of gladiators that have changed priority points there is a small asterisk mark on units whose points are changed.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36651033/8c2b03831ad618d13bf90f7da23bb507d02c7176.jpg[/img]

Overall you are easily able to play the game without ever using this tool if you don’t prefer to go to deep into it. But it’s there to give you an extra thing to play with if you want to.

We’d love to hear your thoughts about this. This feature is still open to changes. 
If you haven’t already, join our [url=https://discord.gg/J7Ja2cK]Discord [/url] and let’s talk about it.



[h2]Random Starting Buildings[/h2]
At start of the game you can turn on a toggle that will semi-randomize the starting gladiator buildings. Making each run a little bit more unique. While turned off, you will still start with default units: Knight, Berserker, and Archer.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36651033/d72e5122a89bac2c181586ad491935c62566777b.jpg[/img]

[h2]Unique Units Shop[/h2]
Sometime between 3rd and 4th month, a quest will appear where bandits or peasants will offer you to hire some of them for your guild.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36651033/0c4f1cb901c988b447103d35f8f70f8efc8986a5.jpg[/img]
As we keep developing the game and adding new units, more random types of shops will appear.
At some later point of development, we’ll also make unique unit shops appear when you reach certain reputations with either of 3 factions. 


[h2]New Soundtrack[/h2]
Ring of death now has a new soundtrack. Intensive version for fight, and passive version for battle preparation.

[h2]Visual[/h2]
-Units have easily noticeable level up animation when they gain level in battle.  
-Opening inventory after battle where unit leveled up will make that units icon glow brightly for a moment. Also their icon has an upwards arrow while they have points to spend. 
-Once unit revives there is a green cross animation, clearly indicating that the unit is back.
-Ring of death has updated borders art making the wall/floor transition look better. 1vs1 has has updated barackade art that fits better.
-Several other minor art improvements in UI.

[h2]Quality of Life[/h2]
-Putting item on unit used to automatically open Unit Info Panel. This usually pretty annoying, especially in battle. Since in most cases you have to close it afterwards. Now this is removed.
-Gladiator Info and Priority Points toggles can be turned on and off by pressing “1” and “2” keyboard keys. 


[h2]Bug Fixes:[/h2]
-Ring of death had 2 panels for clicking fight. Possibly causing some bugs for people who clicked fast twice. 
-Selling item or unit while shop is open is now updating the red indications weather or not you can have enough gold for things in shop.
-Clicking on surrender after wining used to give additional rewards. This is now fixed.



[h2]Gladiator Changes[/h2]

[h3]Ideal Range[/h3]
Gladiators ideal range stat is now more effective.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36651033/f37a2bddc17833449a27bc343ee00b388dc5bf08.jpg[/img]
Hunter used to be very problematic because he would move far away from the target and with his low accuracy it was left to luck if he’ll hit an enemy or not. Now ranged gladiators calculates their Ideal Range more accurately and will not move so far away from the enemy if their projectile precision is not good enough. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36651033/9ee18806a38317e05f970788d6ebdf86768b76d4.jpg[/img]


[h3]Necromancer Nerfed[/h3]
In right circumstances this gladiator is extremely powerful. He can raise so many high level undead that he’s OP for both player and enemy teams.
We did not yet nerf the level of undead he raises. So he can still be a great contribution to your team.
But his initial cooldown is raised from 4 seconds to 15 (can be decreased with agility)
And his execution speed from 0.1 seconds to 1 second (with minimum of 0.2 second with a lot of agility)

[h3]Invigorator Buffed[/h3]
His Divine Vigor is now giving about 20% higher stat boost. 
In combination with his stamina regeneration ability he should be more useful. 




[h1]What’s Next?[/h1]

[h3]Gladiator Stats[/h3]
Updating/balancing gladiator stats so that your point allocation matters more. For example we might make archers damage depend more on strength, while keeping her cooldown and execution speed with agility. This way you’ll decide if you want her to shoot faster or deal higher damage per arrow. This will come in even more handy with passive abilities from items that are also on our next list.

[h3]New items[/h3]
We intend to add a lot more items soon. We will separate them in two types:

[b]-Common Items[/b]
Items that have certain level and give certain amount of stats (pretty much how most of the items are right now)

[b]-Universal Items[/b]
Items that are tied to percentages and synergetic buffs. Like item that makes gladiator deal 30% higher damage to enemies that are frozen. Or item that makes gladiators melee attack freeze enemy. 
Those will not have a level since they will stay consistently useful throughout the whole game. And will enable you to make creative synergetic teams for maximum efficiency. 


[h3]Additional Quests[/h3]
More quests so that each playthrough feels more unique. 


[h3]Feedback[/h3]
We’ve been listening to a lot of feedback and watching people play the game. You guys made a huge contribution to the game by telling us about your experience and about what you'd like to see in the game. But there are still things to change, improve and add. 

Join us in our [url=https://discord.gg/J7Ja2cK]Discord Community[/url] to hang out, keep closer eye on development, and even better, tell us your thoughts about the game and help shape it into the best possible version that all of us will enjoy :)

Thank you!

notes.title: Update v0.600 - Timeline, Weather, Different Arena, Level Up Stats, Discounts
notes.content:
Hey guys! Here is the newest progress of the game. We gathered your feedback from the last big closed beta update and from people following the development. Our main goal right now is to make the gameplay loop more fun, engaging, and with more things to play with.

Join our [url=https://discord.gg/J7Ja2cK]Discord Server[/url] to follow development more closely, talk with us and share your thoughts with the community.

[h1]Here’s what’s new in v0.600:[/h1]

[h2]New Timeline[/h2]
Timelines now consist of a full month with 30 days included, instead of 10.
Throughout the month, the timeline will move to the left, displaying info about things that are coming your way. Those include: gladiator/shop updates, shop discounts, current weather and upcoming weather, when you will have to pay your gladiator’s wages and when the championship is going to happen.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36651033/ba858df8286426fae74247b8a8dfee887ad62223.gif[/img]

Gladiator wages are always at day 30 and are paid automatically (if you don’t have enough gold, the gold will go into negative value, but you will not lose your gladiators).
On the bottom right corner of the screen you’ll see text indicating how much gold was spent on gladiator wages.

Championships are always held on the first day of each month.
The activities you do throughout the month serve to prepare you for the most important part of progressing in the game: winning the championship.

There is now a weather system that affects gladiators in combat. This provides more strategy, as you know which gladiators are less effective during which weather so you can prepare accordingly. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36651033/94f44450d57edff06c966ab3a8f4c176390e794f.gif[/img]
Weather changes affect most arenas. But there are arenas like Ancient Temple or Hollow Mountain that always have the same weather buff so you know what to expect there.

From time to time a gladiator or item shop discount will appear on the timeline and you’ll be able to see how long the discounts last. It will discount random gladiators or items in shop with random discount percentages. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36651033/ada314a6e55f9d87194668118d45d1d88ce4195f.jpg[/img]


[h2]Ring of Death Arena[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36651033/fc402112efb07557765e9be6fb89418525d7a338.jpg[/img]
While preparing for championship at start of the next month, between quests you’ll also be able to play the Ring of Death Arena. After playing this arena, it will become available again in 7 days.

In this arena you’ll be able to choose 3 different modes:
[list]
[*][b]Blind fight[/b]
Choose your gladiators without seeing the enemy team.
[*][b]One VS One[/b]
Choose a single gladiator to fight against an enemy champion.
[*][b]One VS Many[/b]
Choose a single gladiator to fight against many enemies. Another difference here is that enemies can be positioned at any part of the arena and so can your gladiator (no left and right side like in other battles)
[/list]
Each of these will unlock after finishing one championship.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36651033/2b10692d8b761db98fa4d8aea3233bd13d707242.jpg[/img]

[h2]Gladiator Level Up Points[/h2]
Previously, stat points were automatically allocated when gladiators levelled up. From now on, when gladiators level up, you’ll be able to choose which stats you want to put the points in and with that have more control over the progression of your gladiators.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36651033/2bed5e5770c084aef8588b1df8b28567a81297fa.jpg[/img]


You can mouse over gladiator abilities to see how stats affect the calculations of the ability (such as damage, cooldown, etc). We’ll try to explain this in the tutorial once the game is ready for Early Access.
(This was already in the game before. It’s just a reminder since we seen people asking what those stats actually do.)



[h2]More[/h2]
-In the championship, you will only face the types of gladiators that you can hire yourself (or if buildings of those gladiators are available for buying). This feature will shine more once there is a larger pool of gladiators to choose from, making each playthrough more unique.
-Small gladiator AI improvement that helps them target enemies who are dealing higher damage.
-Some bug fixes, visual improvements and other minor things.


[h3]Note:[/h3]
Keep in mind, now that the timeline lasts 30 days, if you stay longer on some championships you might run out of quests. This will be solved by adding more of them soon. But you’ll always have the option to play some of the Ring of Death Arena modes each 7 days. And eventually we’ll add even more things to do, to make the gameplay more dynamic, engaging and interesting (You can read about the new features we plan to add below).



[h1]Plans For Future Updates[/h1]
-Next things we’re planning to focus on is collaboration with local businesses for passive income. There will be a few available businesses, like a small stone mine or woodcutting camp. They will call for your help and you will need to fight several waves of enemies to set them free. After that the local business will give you part of their income, but from time to time they will ask for your protection.
You’ll be able to see passive income indicators on the timeline.

-Synergy for gladiators with various buffs. Example: Item that makes the gladiator deal 30% higher damage to frozen targets, making this gladiator very efficient if paired with the Cryomancer, who can freeze enemies. And many, many other combinations increasing the tactical possibilities of the game.

-First parts of the Main Quest Chains. 
Also more side quests, so there is higher variety in each playthrough and more things to do while preparing for the upcoming championship.

-Expeditions - this feature will probably come a bit later, as it needs a solid amount of work and we have many other things to finish before we get to this. But we started considering it so we want to hear your thoughts about it.
The idea is that you’d be able to buy a guild building that lets you use a caravan and send a number of gladiators on an expedition. You’d see a hand drawn map of a dangerous, uninhabited nearby region that you would explore and dwell deeper into.
There would be no actual battles to look at. You would only send a couple of gladiators and they would be unavailable for a certain amount of days, depending on how far you sent them. 

When they return, they would bring the news of what happened. If they were successful, they would bring you some loot and resources. If not, you’ll need to consider sending stronger troops or a higher number of troops to conquer that part of the map. 
The map would have caves, old buildings/towers occupied by bandits, forests and other locations with valuable loot. Sometimes abandoned, but more often occupied with various enemies that need to be defeated by your caravan party of gladiators. 

We feel like this would be a pretty fun additional thing to do. Planning which gladiators to send, and when to send them to get the most out of them. That is also different from usual battles so it would add to variety in the gameplay and keep things more engaging. 
We’d love to hear your thoughts about this idea.

If you haven’t already, join us in our [url=https://discord.gg/J7Ja2cK]Discord Community[/url] where you can follow up development more closely or chat with us about the direction that the game is going and help us with your feedback to make the best game that we can! :)


Thank you for your patience and all the valuable feedback! We’re working hard on getting the game fun and polished before Early Access, and we’re getting closer and closer.

notes.title: Basic Editor Is Ready To Use In Beta!
notes.content:
Basic editor functions are now ready in beta! 
You can put together friendly and enemy gladiator teams, set their levels, and watch them fight!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36651033/19b88f781b5f97143bba38166fe6f85d6a9fdf3a.png[/img]

There is also an option to copy friendly or enemy team so you can send it to a friend or to our [url=https://discord.gg/J7Ja2cK]Discord Community[/url] to show others the teams that you've made.

Keep in mind that is is just a basic version of the editor and new features are coming. We’re planing on adding options to choose items and quirks for gladiators. And eventually additional abilities for each gladiator. 

Another feature we're planing is Challenge Mode. Where you can create an enemy team, set amount of points player can use to create their team (for gladiators, items, etc) and then send the challenge to a friend. 
We'd also have prepared Challenges that you can load in the game and test your skills.


This features is both something we need for development and a fun toy to play with and test how gladiators work (or don’t work ːsteamhappyː). This will be a huge help in figuring out when the gladiators behaviour breaks, or where they don’t act in the way they should. 
But more importantly, a place for you to test out some strategies and combinations really quickly.

Here’s a quick tutorial about how to use the editor: [url=https://youtu.be/lh9ATHRmsf0]https://youtu.be/lh9ATHRmsf0[/url]

All feedback about what you'd like to see or change in the Editor is more than welcome! Tell us here or in our [url=https://discord.gg/J7Ja2cK]Discord Community[/url].

Also we have new channel on [url=https://discord.gg/J7Ja2cK]Discord[/url] called #share-editor-team where you can share your teams or try teams that others have made.

Thanks for following up on the development of the game! 

Next feature that we’re planing to focus on is changing how timeline works and adding weather effects that will affect all the gladiators in the arena. As well as to update the editor with new features.

notes.title: Let’s Brainstorm Design of a New Type of Arena on Twitch Stream
notes.content:
We’re having a 45 minutes brainstorming session on [url=https://www.twitch.tv/entertainmentforge]Twitch Stream[/url] where you can help us generate ideas for a specific aspect of the game together.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36651033/e7fe2fe658913da4a216db8b0044c969950b68b5.png[/img]

[h2]Change of Design And Reason for New Arena Type[/h2]
In short, here’s the change we’ll make in the game. We want to make Championships a BIG deal. They will be available only at every 30th day (end of the month). And at one point we will also add a boss fights at the end of each championship and of course a larger reward for wining. Making you feel great once you beat the championship and move forward in the game.
But during these 30 days we’ll have quest, and we also want to add another type of arena that can be started at any point you want to. But after finishing it, it would have 7 days cooldown before it can be played again. 

[h2]Theme of the Brainstorming Session[/h2]
[b]The theme of this brainstorming session is this new arena[/b] that will be playable at any point with 7 days of cooldown. 

The current idea that we have for this new arena (Ring of Death - current name) would let you choose 3 types of gameplay whenever you start it (it can be more than 3 if we figure out more fun things)

[list]
[*][b]Blind Fight  [/b]
You select your team and lock it down. And only after choosing your gladiators, you will see the enemy team appear. You can then change positions of your gladiators and items they carry. But you can not change the gladiators themselves.
[*][b]1vs1 Melee Fight [/b]
Here you can see the gladiator that you are about to fight. But arena has barricades around fighters making it very small, so it’s intended for proving your strongest melee fighting gladiator.
[*][b]Betting[/b]
Two teams are already in the arena. And you can place a bet on the team you think will win (not using your gladiators at all)
[/list]

We are still thinking about those types of gameplay and want to make them more interesting. Perhaps we can have more than 3 type, and then as you progress in the game, new random modes would be unlocked.
But what better way to think about new types of gameplay, than to brainstorm it with you guys :)

So in this [url=https://www.twitch.tv/entertainmentforge]Twitch Stream[/url] what we want to brainstorm with you the new and interesting gameplay types that can be chosen in this arena. 


[h2]Here are the few guidelines:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Once we start brainstorming I’ll set the counter and brainstorming will last 45 minutes. (If you still have ideas after the 45 minutes expire, join our [url=https://discord.gg/J7Ja2cK]Discord Community[/url] and tell us about them in #feedback channel)
[*] I will not judge any idea. At this stream we only want to generate as much as possible.
[*] Write anything you like, no matter if it’s wrong or ridiculous. Bad or out of place ideas can be an excellent pathway for a new more creative and excellent ideas that we wouldn’t arrive at if we didn’t start with wrong idea that lead us up to the right one.
[*] You’re encouraged to build upon or get inspired by ideas presented by others, in order to generate new ideas.
[*] Stay on subject of this “New Arena Gameplay Types”. (You can write ideas related to other subjects in #feedback in our [url=https://discord.gg/J7Ja2cK]Discord Community[/url]) (And we’ll have more streams like this with other specific aspects of the game too)
[/list]


After a day or two, Danijel and me (Darko) will work those ideas out, see what fits the game, maybe build upon them or adjust them. And then I’ll do another stream where we can discuss and evaluate those selected/adjusted ideas.

[b]Here is our Twitch Channel Link: [/b]
[url=https://www.twitch.tv/entertainmentforge]https://www.twitch.tv/entertainmentforge[/url]

Stream will start in less than 2 hours from now (countdown in on [url=https://www.twitch.tv/entertainmentforge]twitch page[/url]).

If you miss it. You can still give us your thoughts on the new Arena Type in the #feedback at our [url=https://discord.gg/J7Ja2cK]Discord Community[/url].

So let’s have a chat and figure out how to make the game as fun as possible! :)

notes.title: Tell Us Your Feedback About Final Design (Or check out what we're planing)
notes.content:
After considering your feedback and our thoughts on how the features from the new update are working out, we brainstormed some final changed and additions to what the main gameplay loop will look like. 

Here are the changes and new features. Tell us your thoughts about them :)


[h1]Timeline[/h1]
We wanted to change the timeline to last 30 days but also to move forwards like this:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36651033/be899315926299ceefe1fe0f127a41e978659411.gif[/img]

It would tell you what kind of weather is coming (weather will affect all gladiators in the arena), as well as when gladiator and item shop updates are. At day 30 the main championships would be organized. 

[h2]Championship[/h2]
We want championship to be a big deal that happens once a month. We'll add more things in between to do (gonna talk about it right after this). 
We noticed that you guys enjoyed the boss fighting quests in beta. So we are thinking about adding an unique boss/champion at the end of each arena, that you'd need to defeat in order to prove yourself and unlock the next arena. Making it even more satisfying when you conquer the arena. 

[h1]Ring of Death Arena[/h1]
While you're preparing for championship other than doing quests, you'd be also able to join The Ring of Death Arena. This arena would be available right away, but after playing it, it would require 7 days until it become available again.

Here you'd get to choose 3 types of games:
[list]
[*] Blind Fight - You would set up your team and lock them up. Only then the enemy team would be revealed. You won't be able to change your gladiators, but you'll be able to change their position and items.
[*] 1vs1 Fight - Here gladiators would have a very small fighting area and both you and the enemy will have just one gladiator. Place to prove your best fighter.
[*] Betting - If you choose this type of arena, you're not putting your gladiators into arena. Instead you'll see two gladiator teams and be able to bet gold on the one that you think will win the fight.
[/list]
We believe that this will refresh gameplay and let you guys do something different.

[h1]Passive Income[/h1]
There will be several places of business in the map, unlocking as you progress. They will need your protection.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36651033/852780c2ff1e7714d0b0cc4a0594c84f3bbd75be.jpg[/img]
At first you'll need to defeat several teams of enemies (bandits, undead, beasts, etc) and then you'll make a deal with this place where they will give you passive income every 15 days in return for your protection. The place might get attacked again and you'll have limited time to defend it before it's taken away.

[h2]Conclusion[/h2]
These are main changes/additions we have in mind to make the final gameplay loop more fun and with more variety. Of course other features that we talked about are coming as well, but we need to make sure the main gameplay loop is fun and that we can build upon that. 

What are your thoughts on these ideas? You can tell us here or join our [url=https://discord.gg/J7Ja2cK]Discord Community[/url] and talk with us there.

Thank you!

notes.title: Biggest Beta Update Is Finally Here!
notes.content:
This took some serious time! But we had to add all these features at the same time.
On the bright side, this means that today we have the biggest update of the game so far! ːsteamhappyː

If you own Beta, try it out and tell us what you think. If not, you can check how things are progressing towards Early Access and tell us your thoughts all the same.

You can talk with us or follow the development more closely by joining our [url=https://discord.gg/J7Ja2cK]Discord Community[/url] 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36651033/cda0f3e5559b1a25318a2f4dd7bc1574c2cd5b71.png[/img]

[h1]What's New?[/h1]

[h2]Updated Gladiator Guild [/h2]
Now it’s simplified and made into a panel because there was no purpose in previous design where you would place buildings around each other. We got feedback from many people that this was the weakest part of the game. Here is what’s new:
[list]
[*] Two random gladiator buildings unlock after finishing each arena.
[*] There is Revival Temple building that lets you bring units back from death (this is disabled on PermaDeath mode).
[*] Gladiator and Inventory slots can be upgraded at bottom of the panel.
[*] Upgrading specific gladiator building increased that gladiators inventory space and experience gain.
[/list]
[h2]Updated Gladiator Info Panel[/h2]

[list]
[*] Panel is visually changed to nicely show all stats and quirks.
[*] More stats are now shown like: Range and Type of Attack.
Knowing Type of Attack is useful because you can compare it to enemy defences and see what kinds of attacks they can defend from (and vice versa).
[/list]
[h2]Timeline[/h2]
There are days, weeks, and years (no days limitations anymore).
In upcoming updates this feature will be connected with weather system.

[h2]Gladiator Wages[/h2]
At middle of the week you'll need to pay gladiators wages. Higher level and better gladiator quirks makes their wages higher. 

[h2]Gladiators Dying and Reviving[/h2]
Now gladiators die in normal more too. But you can revive them. This will cost you a mana crystal and time. Higher level gladiators take more days to get revived. You can upgrade Reviving Temple in guild to reduce the time it takes. (PermaDeath mode still exists but in this mode there is no reviving)

[h2]Quests and Events[/h2]
During the week quests will appear from different factions asking you for favors.
Championships are organized at end of the week and quests serve to help you prepare. 

[h2]Faction Reputations[/h2]
You have reputation with each of the 3 factions. Higher the reputation, higher the quest rewards. But in future updates we’ll add the main quest lines for each of those factions and you’ll need reputation to start those quests and also to continue the next ones.

[h2]Boss Fights[/h2]
You may encounter two boss fights in quests. 

[h2]Bank[/h2]
Place where you can buy or sell resources. Also where you can loan some coin to bounce back if you find yourself in bad situation.

[h2]Custom Gladiator Heads[/h2]
You can put a transparent PNG file to replace any gladiators head (experimental feature so we can’t guarantee it will work on every computer yet)


[h1]Units[/h1]
[h2]New[/h2]
[list]
[*]Old Villager (Placeholder name)
Villager with pitchfork
[*]Tank Villager (Placeholder name)
Villager with wooden shield that protects massive amounts of damage but the shield breaks after a certain amount of damage taken.
[*]Female Villager (Placeholder name)
Villager who throws knifes with low accuracy but with great strength that will knock the opponent down.
[*]Forest Troll (Boss) 
(We had him in the game before but didn’t use him since there were no quests)
Has huge health and damage. Melee attack that attacks single gladiator, and Smash ability that hits everybody around him. 
[*]Undead Yeti (Boss) 
Has strong attack that knocks enemy down with every hit. Also a Thick Fur, passive ability that blocks 80% damage from ranged and explosion attack types.
[/list]
[h2]Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Priestess
Does not restores stamina any more and has longer cooldowns. 
(Still very useful with shield and heal, but not overpowered like she used to be (hopefully))

[*] Invigorator 
Has new ability to restore stamina. 
His Diving Vigor that boosts gladiators main stat is 80% stronger. 

[*] Horn Beast
Has Dense Fur passive ability that blocks 30% of the damage from ranged and explosion attack types.

[*] More
We made minor balancing to other units like nerfing Berserker a little bit, buffing Archer, making Hunter less accurate as he’s really good at keeping melee units away from him, but should not be that great against ranged units. And many other small tweaks to other gladiators.
[/list]

[h3]Items[/h3]
Consumable items are now 50% stronger than ordinary items of the same level. Use them smartly when odds are not in your favor. 


[h2]Thank you![/h2]
Thank you for following our games development and all the support! If you have any feedback or want to hang out with us and keep closer look on how development is going, join our: [url=https://discord.gg/J7Ja2cK]Discord Community [/url] ːsteamhappyː

notes.title: Update v0.429 - Quirks affecting gladiator cost, new quirks art, and bug fixes
notes.content:
-Quirk placeholder icons are replaced with final icons.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36651033/ac99080e134a76fe83517003c69b40f11b395ba7.jpg[/img]

Gladiator cost is no longer randomized. Now it depends on two factors:
[list]
[*]How many arenas have you have beaten. If you are at arena 1 and there is level 3 gladiator, it will be very expensive because average enemy gladiator is level 1 at this point. But once you reach arena where gladiator level 3 is average enemy gladiator, then new level 3 gladiators in shop will be less expensive.
[*]Positive or Negative Quirks multiply or divide the price. For example gladiator with negative quirk [b]Heavy Smoker[/b] will cost 30% less, while gladiator with positive quirk [b]Last Stand[/b] will be 20% more expensive.

notes.title: V 0.427 - Quality of Life, Polishing and Bug Fixing
notes.content:
- Now you can roll over unit during battle preparation and see a pop up with items. Before this, you could see this pop up only while rolling over icon. Now that we have consumable items, this is very useful to quickly check what units have free slots.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36651033/a3b78ea6a91012cece78a07976a8182e9008c9a6.jpg[/img]

- Ability pop up in Unit Info Panel now show name of ability together with cooldown percentage. 
- In buff roll over panel, duration stat is added (for buffs that have duration like Knockdown or Freeze)
- Added Surrender button while battle is in progress. 
- Ability description was not showing duration stat correctly for some abilities like Frost Bolt. Now it’s accurate and it’s also dynamic stat so it can increase or decrease with certain stat (like Strength in this example). 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36651033/c66a32fd9190a1ac29328b13e8fdcae77a48450f.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36651033/e6a3e7bdffa77b16a8f349f929a4e55538dfeae0.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36651033/c1733938f57f493dd50d3fd4f514b90fae4d36e9.jpg[/img]

- Surrender button is added on left button part of the screen. It's a current solution for those impossible situations where units get stuck chasing each other. But we're considering some additional solutions for the problem as well.
-Many of you have been complaining about Priestess being too powerful with her short cooldowns and that it was an easy way to beat the game. So Priestess cooldowns for Heal and Shield abilities are doubled (starting values are increased to 8 second, from previous 4 seconds). But the amount of health of heal and shield are 40% higher in order to still keep her useful.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36651033/4ba25c4aad68c1ddca4c4ba75ea18f91e1bc24f7.jpg[/img]

We tested it out and now she prioritizes smarter. We hope it will make gladiators a bit more predictable. But if this causes other unpredictable behaviours that we didn’t notice in our testing please let us know.

- Rock Imp's Throw Rock ability localization text fixed.
- Unlock slots for items in hostile units fixed.
- Lonely particle effect above the temple arena removed.

-There is special kind of buffs that take over control of the gladiator (Knockdown, terror...). Those were not being shown in buff (quirks) list. Now they are.
- All projectiles now disappear as soon as the battle ends. We had problems with hunters trap staying after the battle.

notes.title: Quirks, Consumable Items, Real Time Ability Stats And More In Update 0.425
notes.content:
[h1]Quirks[/h1]
Gladiators can now have a few random quirks assigned to them. Positive, negative or dependent on situation.
Thing to keep in mind about quirks is that art is still under development. So right now we have random sketches that don’t even match what quirks are (since they are barely visible as sketches). But soon we’ll replace them with actual icons that are on their way. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36651033/798173b899e443446027d18bc9005ec8d2fbe044.jpg[/img]
We currently have 16 quirks and more are on their way.

[h1]Consumable Items[/h1]
Consumable items are consumed after the battle is finished. They are much cheaper and more frequent then ordinary items. Goal of this feature is to give more options for preparation before the battle starts. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36651033/6fefddacf25bbbeb1a04c94771e776cb3d84c398.jpg[/img]

[h1]Real Time Ability Stats[/h1]
Now by clicking or rolling over gladiator we’ll be able to see what ability gladiator is using, what ability is on cooldown, and if some ability is lacking stamina to be used. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36651033/1ea38ec0e052206cae2af6a94b094140e528a46a.jpg[/img]
Also by opening gladiator panel we can see their stats in real time. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36651033/1716b6ba22e4cd1c574b8c90f7214ac540974084.jpg[/img]
This was important because Quirks are now changing stats and affecting gladiators in crucial ways. 


[h1]Other[/h1]
-Gladiators in shop that are much higher level than predicted for that stage of your progress are way more expensive. Before, it was very easy to win the first arena by buying level 3 gladiators while enemy teams expect you to have level 1 gladiators. Now if you want to buy a really strong gladiator it will cost much more.
On the other hand, game is a bit easier because there are now affordable consumable items that you can use to your advantage.
-We risen number of item slots from 4 to 6. 
-They do not unlock automatically anymore. Now they cost a small amount of gold. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36651033/cad60852fe41a326f0c8e8467dcc8f536c9ed629.jpg[/img]


[h1]What is Next?[/h1]
-First we want to polish up the current quirk system (make them unlock with new arenas, balance positive and negative ones so there is not much unfair situations)
-Add new quirks. 
-In shop we want to make gladiators price depend on quality of quirks and add discounts feature. 
-Show quirks on unit roll over.
-Show gladiators target on unit roll over.
-Item rarity feature (Each item will have 4 different rarity versions, making it stronger or weaker version of itself)
-Fix few known and probably more unknown bugs.
-Polish and balance game some more.

Updates will be more frequent in next several weeks. But after all that is done we are moving towards next big update that will include:
-Real time passing
-New gladiator stats like Morale, Fame and Monthly Wages.
-Guild with fixed building locations, options to train gladiators to learn new abilities, resurrect them, heal injuries, regain morale, and more.
-Quests and Events that will occur between championships which will be available every 15 days. 


Thanks you all for huge support! Join our [url=https://discord.gg/J7Ja2cK]Discord Community[/url] if you already haven't where we talk about the game and brainstorm all kinds of ideas.

notes.title: Real Time Info For Abilities and Stats In Battle, Consumable Items (Only Info)

notes.title: Beta Is Ready For KS Backers! Also Let's Talk About The Design of The Full Game!
notes.content:
Huge thanks to everybody who backed us on Kickstarter!
Everyone who got Beserker pledge or higher is soon going to be contacted with beta key.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36651033/884d7cdfc1ea55a971d83659942f0a8f002239bc.jpg[/img]

As we said, Beta will be very similar to [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1332470/Gladiator_Guild_Manager_Prologue/]Prologue[/url] at start. But the point is to see the game grow and develop. But we felt bad, releasing it exactly like Prologue so we added two new arenas and three simple enemies. Just so you guys have a little bit more to play with. It's not much since enemies are simple and they will need additional abilities in future. 

But here is the thing. Our goal right now is not to add new content but new features like we talked in this: [url=https://docs.google.com/document/d/1SwAaQIye8KglWdrQq32po-LcYt6w57gHubU-t2c0Jl0/edit?usp=sharing]Design Document For Full Game[/url]

So join us in discussion. Either here in comments, or in this [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1332470/discussions/0/5383446733864795293/]Community Hub[/url] post, or in our [url=https://discord.gg/J7Ja2cK]Discord[/url].

Right now we will be focusing on two things. We'll be brainstorming ideas with you guys until we decide on all the details for design of the Full Game. And at the same time we'll be tweaking/fixing/polishing gladiators AI and fixings other issues and bugs in the game.


[b]Beta Version Updates:[/b]
[list]
[*]Iron Town Arena is added
[*]Hollow Mountain Arena is added
[*]Claw Imp and Rock Imp are added as enemies in Iron Town Arena (They will eventually be moved to Temple arena. And they will get additional abilities. Right now they are pretty basic)
[*]Horn Beast is added as enemy to Hollow Mountain arena (Eventually the damage and force of it's "Knock Away" ability will depend on how quickly the Horn Beast is running as it hits the enemy)
[/list]



One more thing. People who missed Kickstarter have been asking how can they buy the beta access now. We are considering adding a donation button on our website. But it's still something we're thinking about and figuring out. We'll keep you guys updated.

Thanks!
-Entertainment Forge Team

notes.title: Gladiator Guild Manager - Development Progress
notes.content:
The new demo is coming along nicely. A lot of progress has been made from the previous version and here are some new things that we can show:

Core gameplay loop is now revolving around the map that you’ll be able to explore:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36651033/f322dc0390bcaf942e2282a0513ad6291369ff05.jpg[/img]

There are arenas to compete in. Rising through the ranks of each will open new parts of the map and unlock new arenas. Shops for fighters and items are now placed on map and by progressing through the game a new and different kinds of shops will become available. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36651033/6322646b1f8205866baf30ebbbb63a35bf4cde93.png[/img]

We’re working now on adding quests that will appear around the map and we’re also planing on adding dungeons that will present a different kind of challenge. Getting as deep as you can, defeating all sorts of monstrosities and looting resources and items to help you grow your guild and team.

Another important update is the new guild building mechanic:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36651033/78e8632a4c3ff2eb18f9e86af8b49ff13fd13889.png[/img]

Buildings that you choose to build and how far you upgrade them will determine what sort of gladiators you can hire and how far you can develop them. 

Guild buildings will cost various resources like wood, stone, metal or mana crystals. But you’ll also need to expand your territory and unlock new slots by defeating enemies in the new woods arena.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36651033/47b25724716274f8863b81713ddfe996c114f765.jpg[/img]

Also, we made a new Kickstarter page that you can follow if you wish to hear more or support us:
